source.name: Colorlib Bootstrap Templates Bedrock
source.rightsEvidence: The pinned repository is MIT licensed. This template's retained CREDITS.txt identifies every photo as CC0 or Public Domain Mark. The MIT license and per-template image credits are stored in this dossier.

provenance.capture: Pinned MIT template rendered locally; CC0/Public Domain assets are evidenced by per-template CREDITS.txt. The mobile capture clips a closed off-canvas drawer that otherwise inflated screenshot width without changing visible content.
provenance.attribution: Colorlib Bootstrap Templates, MIT. Preserve the MIT notice in derivative/source distributions.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A dark industrial contractor page with a small tender/contact bar, a very large stacked headline over a construction photo, a compact metric ribbon, capability grid, sector list, project portfolio, staged enquiry process, accreditation bar, and a tender request form. The included construction imagery is CC0/Public Domain per the template's credit file.

heroGeometry.mode: oversized industrial poster over a wide construction-site image
heroGeometry.alignment: large stacked type left with image field supporting the right half
heroGeometry.viewport: logo, promise, short body and tender action fit within the first desktop viewport

navigationGeometry.placement: top edge with compact in-page section links
navigationGeometry.mobile: brand and one action remain visible; utility links collapse to a short row

typography.scale: large stacked headline, uppercase micro-labels, concise body copy

palette.contrastIntent: industrial clarity with yellow used only for the action and active markers

imageTreatment.mode: CC0 construction-site photograph with darkened type-safe overlay
imageTreatment.crop: wide hero cover and small rectangular project crops
imageTreatment.focalPoint: crane/site activity behind the headline; project work remains visible in lower image tiles

servicePresentation.pattern: capability grid followed by a numbered sector ledger
servicePresentation.interaction: simple in-page section navigation and case-study links

ctaPlacement.primary: request a tender in the top utility bar and hero
ctaPlacement.early: inside the hero after the concise project promise

motion.primitive: native section navigation with a discreet light/dark control
motion.reducedMotion: static image, grid and process sequence

rules: scale headline before changing visual order
put the project action before capability details
stack the sector ledger and process
retain project-photo crops without horizontal overflow

prohibitedPatterns: decorative numbered services without business meaning

requiredSignatureElements.description: oversized stacked promise over a construction-site field
scannable sectors or capability ledger with factual labels
project images that function as evidence rather than decoration
closing scope-request form paired with tender context

acceptanceChecks: one-screen desktop opening at 100 percent zoom
projects are presented as evidence and use approved assets
only verified credentials and outcomes appear
tender request has a clear next step
mobile keeps the poster, project proof and CTA sequence usable

review.scope: MIT source pin, CC0 image credits, paired captures, and transferable design mechanics
